m: परि-√ 1. धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, (pf. -दधुर्, -दधिरे; fut. -धास्यति; aor. -धात्, -धीमहि; ind.p. -धाय; Ved. inf. परि-धातवै), to lay or put or place or set round, RV. &c. &c.; to cast round, turn upon (दृष्टिम्, with loc. Hariv.); to put on, wear (with or sc. वासस्), dress, VS.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.; surround, envelop, enclose, RV. &c. &c.; to conclude or close (the recitation of a hymn), TS.; Br. : Caus. -धापयति (ind.p. ˚यित्वा, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 38, Sch.), to cause a person to wrap round or put on (2 acc.), Br. &c.; to clothe with (instr.), AV. : Desid. -धित्सते, to wish to put on MBh.
a: परिधा — {c3c} U. 1 To put or wear (as a garment); त्वचं स मेध्यां परिधाय रौरवीं R. 3. 31. --2 To surround, enclose. --3 To direct towards. --4 To put or place round. --5 To cast round the eyes, turn the glance upon. --6 To conclude, close (as the recitation of a hymn). --Caus. To cause to put on, clothe with.

a: परि(री)धानं — 1 Putting on a garment, dressing. --2 A garment, especially an undergarment, clothes in general; आत्तचित्रपरिधानविभूषाः Ki. 9. 1; Śi. 1. 61; 4. 68; Pt. 5. 23. --3 Closing or concluding. --4 Ved. Putting round.

m: परि-धि m. an enclosure, fence, wall, protection, (esp.) the 3 fresh sticks (called मध्यम, दक्षिण, उत्तर) laid round a sacrificial fire to keep it together, RV. &c. &c.

(fig.) the ocean surrounding the earth, ib.

the horizon, MBh.; BhP.
any circumference or circle, Var.; Sūryas.
epicycle, ib.
the branch of the tree to which the sacrificial victim is tied (?), W.

a: परिधिः — 1 A wall, fence, hedge, anything surrounding or enclosing another. --2 A misty halo round the sun or moon; परिधेर्मुक्त इवोष्णदीधितिः R. 8. 30; शशिपरिधिरिवोच्चैर्मंडलस्तेन तेने N. 2. 108. --3 A circle of light --4 The horizon. --5 The circumference or compass in general. --6 The circumference of a circle. --7 The periphery of a wheel. --8 A stick (of a sacred tree like पलाश) laid round the sacrificial fire; सप्तास्यासन् परिधयः त्रिःसप्त समिधः कृताः Rv. 10. 90. 15. --9 A circle surrounding the globe. --10 Epicycle. --11 A covering. --12 A branch of a sacred tree to which the sacrificial victim is tied. --Comp. --पतिखेचरः an epithet of Śiva. --स्थः {1} a guard. {2} an officer attendant on a king or general (modern ‘aide-de-camp’). {3} A number of sentinels posted in a circle.
